response.rationale: R5 directly names the cystic tongue-base mass identified on laryngoscopy and CT, which is the most likely diagnosis. C1 is a correlated append-only restatement of R5 with an added complication and should be discounted as a separate diagnostic entity. R3 is the downstream obstructive sleep apnea syndrome caused by the mass, while R2 and R4 are unrelated comorbidities.
